description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying at most {4}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.
